chunks: He said: Abu Bakr Muhammad ibn Umar al-Ji'abi reported to me, saying: Abu al-Abbas Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Sa'id al-Hamdani narrated to us, saying: Umar ibn Aslam narrated to us, saying: Sa'id ibn Yusuf al-Basri narrated to us, from Khalid ibn Abd al-Rahman al-Mada'ini, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Layla, from Abu Dharr al-Ghifari, may Allah be pleased with him, who said:

I saw the Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and his family and grant them peace, pat the shoulder of Ali ibn Abi Talib, peace be upon him, with his hand and say: "O Ali, whoever loves us is the true Arab, and whoever hates us is the lowly non-Arab. Our Shi'ah are people of noble houses, distinguished origins, and honor, and those of legitimate birth. None follows the creed of Ibrahim, peace be upon him, except us and our Shi'ah, and the rest of the people are dissociated from it. And indeed Allah has angels who demolish the sins of our Shi'ah just as a pick demolishes a structure."

key_terms.العلج: Al-'ilj: a coarse, uncouth non-Arab; used here metaphorically to denote spiritual baseness rather than ethnic identity
key_terms.القدوم: Al-qadum: a pick or adze used for demolition; used as a simile for the thorough erasure of sins
key_terms.المعادن: Al-ma'adin: literally 'mines' or 'sources'; here meaning noble origins or essence
key_terms.ملة إبراهيم: Millat Ibrahim: the creed/path of Prophet Ibrahim (Abraham), representing pure monotheism

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad say about the followers (Shi'ah) of Ahl al-Bayt?
ai.summary: In this prophetic tradition narrated by the esteemed companion Abu Dharr al-Ghifari, the Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) affirms the spiritual nobility of those who love the Ahl al-Bayt, declaring them followers of the creed of Ibrahim. The Prophet addresses Imam Ali (AS) directly, equating love for the Prophet's family with true nobility regardless of ethnic origin, and announcing that God has appointed angels specifically tasked with erasing the sins of their followers.

en.mulla-asgharali-m-m-jaffer: 4. He said: Abu Bakr Muhammad ibn Umar al-Ji’abi reported to me from Abul Abbas Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Saeed al-Hamdani, who reported from Umar ibn Aslam, who reported from Saeed ibn Yusuf al-Basri, from Khalid ibn Abdul Rahman al-Madayeni, from Abdul Rahman ibn Abi Layla, from Abu Dharr al-Ghifari - may Allah be pleased with him, who said:

I saw the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his progeny, stroke the shoulders of ‘Ali ibn Abi Talib, peace be upon him and say: "O ‘Ali, whoever loves us is from pure Arab breed and those who hate us are the non-Arab infidels. Our Shi’ahs are people of noble descent and honour, and are of legitimate birth. And there is none on the path of Ibrahim except those who are our Shi’ahs; the rest of the people are away from it. And Allah has appointed angels who demolish the sins of our Shi’ahs, the way a pick destroys a structure."
